Title: API Management Diagnostics now available in public preview

Body.Content:
The public preview release of the API Management Diagnostics feature provides a quick and easy experience to help customers:

  • Troubleshoot issues without requiring configuration
  • Analyze API resources using charts, status data, and graphs
  • Leverage intelligent document searches to provide relevant and contextual resources and solutions

This capability allows customers to identify and address key issues, reducing the need to engage in generating and managing support cases.  Potential problems that the tool can help resolve include:

  • APIs returning a status code of 200, but with no response body
  • APIs returning status code 4xx or 5xx errors
  • Slow performance of APIs

Find additional information.

Learn more.
